static_traits.name: Chen Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but struggles to discuss Social anxiety with them; Interpersonal relationships affected by negative thoughts and avoiding eye contact
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;not yet received other psychotherapy; other psychological problem history Not mentioned
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to explain their own thoughts and feelings; positive attitude, high cooperation; subjectively feels nervous; able to accept homework and suggestions

basic_info.main_problem: Has difficulty making eye contact in social interactions, and believes friends think they are strange and only associate with them out of sympathy.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing Social anxiety and negative thoughts about friendship affect daily life and mental health, hence seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: Experienced several embarrassing social events in adolescence; since then, trying to avoid eye contact in Social situations, gradually forming Social anxiety about group interactions and worry about others' negative evaluations.

core_beliefs: I am a strange person who evokes pity
Others do not really like me; they are only friends with me out of pity

special_situations.event: Talking with friends at Social gatherings and noticing someone giving 'strange looks'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot maintain eye contact or see others showing unusual expressions, it means they think I am strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to avoid eye contact, reducing speaking and interaction in group settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are judging me; they are only friends with me out of pity

special_situations.event: Thinks about communicating honestly with friends and seeking clarification
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my worries and unease, others will think I am overreacting and start pitying me more
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing Social anxiety and eye contact issues with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will start treating me differently and pity me more

special_situations.event: After recalling experiences of friends' past support and understanding
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even positive interactions do not mean they really like me; these good behaviors are just out of pity
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence, continuing to interpret relationships from a negative perspective
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They only support me out of pity

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely accepted and understood and to build natural, comfortable connections with others
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and humiliated, worrying that others only feel sympathy rather than genuinely liking oneself
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged and humiliated by reducing self-exposure and keeping a certain distance
Avoids eye contact to maintain a sense of safety and controllability

object_relations.object_representation: Judging others (friends) who only pity and never truly accept

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests seeking clarification from friends and openly discussing worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think this will make friends look down on them more, only pitying them more (projecting inner shame and worries of not being accepted onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Fully empathizing with their worries in a supportive, gentle tone, then using concrete facts and examples for Socratic Questioning, gently challenging the inference 'they will look down on me', avoiding confrontation or judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'is there concrete evidence of friends' negative views'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client emphasizes others' looks and 'looking strange', using it as a reason not to communicate with friends, ignoring positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a neutral and curious tone, guides them to make the details and situations of the 'strange looks' concrete, and at the same time jointly lists pros and cons evidence and alternative explanations, reducing defensive intensity.

manifestations: Feels alienated from others in group settings because of avoiding eye contact
Worrying friends only get along with oneself out of pity, thus not daring to communicate openly

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting others' gazes and expressions as judgments of oneself
Believes friends associate with oneself only out of sympathy

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-Reflection and introspection, containing excessive self-limitation and self-harshness, being overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-focusing on others' gazes and reactions, avoiding eye contact
Worrying about being seen as 'overreacting' after being honest and choosing not to communicate

exception_events.target_problem: When communicating with friends or groups, the client usually avoids eye contact and assumes others have negative evaluations of them, thus feeling more Anxiety, Distant relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few times when getting along with friends, the client felt relatively comfortable; friends showed understanding and support, and he did not avoid as strongly as usual, with smoother interactions.
exception_events.reason: Different support: friends expressed understanding and acceptance at these moments; different situation/approach: the client subjectively felt more comfortable at the time, thus more willing to engage.

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and has a positive attitude
Able to identify and express one's own negative automatic thoughts
Has a few friends to communicate with and has experienced their support
negative_force: Significant Social anxiety in group situations
Mind reading and personalization tendencies, prone to ignoring positive evidence
Avoiding eye contact causing decreased interaction quality and Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding eye contact in social interactions
target_behavior.core_reason: After embarrassing social experiences in adolescence, worry about being judged and a mind-reading tendency formed, leading to avoidance of eye contact
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the potential risk of being judged/shamed, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Distant Interpersonal relationships, Work performance affected, Lowered self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Significant Social anxiety in group settings
antecedent: Moments requiring public interaction or being noticed
target_behavior.core_reason: Based on past embarrassing experiences and Anticipation of others' negative evaluations, tending to catastrophically Interpret social cues
target_behavior.function: Avoids being noticed and evaluated by others, seeks a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduces expression and participation, hard to maintain intimate relationships, daily interactions affected
